correctness.rationale: The two explicitly specified blowup valuation chains give v_e2(X^aY^bZ^c)=a+2b on Z=1 and v_fn(X^aY^bZ^c)=b+nc on X=1, from transformations y=x^2 w and q=p^n s. Requiring both exceptional valuations >=m yields b>=c and a<=(n-1)c. The monomial initial terms are distinct, hence no cancellation; every allowed monomial factors as U^(b-c) times c among T_j with indices summing a. The sorted-index quadratic relations are the full toric ideal; lattice saturation gives normality. Summing monomials yields rational Hilbert series, checked for 328 (n,m) pairs, which does not itself verify blowup geometry. final_claim: For the explicit Guo–Hu–Lü plane-foliation reduced models S_n (n>=2), the foliated canonical ring is a normal monomial semigroup ring generated by U=Y of degree 1 and T_j=X^j YZ of degrees j+2, 0<=j<n, with rational-normal-curve 2x2 minor relations.
